billingDetailsTitle: Know what starts now, and what comes later.
faqItems: How do the cashier and kitchen connect?
Submitting a cashier order confirms it and creates its kitchen ticket. The kitchen team then moves the ticket through preparation states.
The demonstrated flow lets a guest browse the menu and submit a cash-on-delivery order. Staff confirm it before it enters the kitchen.
What can I customize on my storefront?
Theme color editing, saving and previewing are demonstrated. Public hostname setup is separate; instant publishing and arbitrary page creation are not promised.
How does the free trial start?
Create a restaurant account to begin a 14-day trial. Then configure restaurant information, add products and try a supported order workflow.
Does selecting annual billing charge me?
Selecting a billing preference does not initiate a payment. Paid checkout is not available here; paid activation requires separate confirmation.
The public website supports both languages and right-to-left layout. Product captures are labelled with their language; complete translation of every application screen is not implied.
